race.description: Golden Eagle & Derby Day – 31 October Mdn Hcp
race.comment: PEERLESS SON (3) progressed nicely last time out to finish just a long neck from the winner in second over 1250m at Gunnedah after being in the firing line on the bend. Ideally placed and is sure to give this a mighty shake. MINERS MATE (10) is close to breaking through after two consecutive placings, the latest coming when third over 1200m at Tamworth. Well placed and there is no reason he cannot find winning ways. KOJAK (2) raced on the pace last start before fading to finish sixth over 1800m at Sunshine Coast. Drops sharply in trip for this bit rates well and deserves another chance. DENISE'S GAL (12) should push forward from the low draw and give a sight.
